messages:
alex chen: Morning — planning a non-prod-first deploy for the orders table split (additive column + consumer changes). Proposing a dual-write window Thu 02:30-03:30 UTC, followed by an async backfill. Need deploy owner, rollback watcher, and canary backfill owner.

maria gomez: I can be deploy owner. Can we nudge start to 02:30 instead of 02:00? I have another window at 01:45.

samir: I can take rollback/watch for the first 2 hours. Will run smoke checks. What backfill approach are we using — online streaming or bulk?

alex chen: We'll use streaming consumer backfill (non-blocking). Plan: enable dual-write, run small canary backfill, then ramp. No blocking DDLs.

priya: I can own the canary backfill. What does the smoke checklist look like?

alex chen: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- enable dual-write on canary tenants
- run sample write/read test (5 tenants)
- run schema-validation job (validate new column present + reads)
- run consumer backfill on sample set
- verify p95 latency < 200ms and error rate < 1%
```
Rollback plan (short): toggle dual-write off, route writes back to old path, pause consumers, revert config. DB admin to ensure gateway TTL/consistency.

jamie: deploy-bot: I can schedule the job at 02:30 UTC and trigger the runbook. Will tag the release as 2026.03.18-orders-split. :rocket:

maria gomez: 02:30 works for me. alex — can you confirm snapshot?

samir: I'll run smoke.sh and tail consumer logs during the window:
```
./smoke.sh --tenants 5 --timeout 600
tail -f /var/log/consumer.backfill.log | grep -E "error|WARN"
```
If I see >2% errors or p50 latency >250ms, I pause.

priya: noted. Full backfill ETA?

alex chen: Full backfill estimate 6-8 hours for full dataset at our throttle. It's async and will be throttled to 100r/s. Pause conditions: >2% error rate OR p50 latency >250ms OR downstream replica lag >30s.

deploy-bot: scheduled job 2142159000 by jamie

maria gomez: Do we need a DB snapshot prior to enabling dual-write?

ops-runner: snapshot job queued for 2026-03-18 01:45 UTC (ID: snap-2142158000).

jamie: Short rollback checklist I'll run if needed:
- pause backfill consumers
- disable dual-write feature flag
- verify writes only hit legacy path
- revert traffic tag and monitor 30m
I'll keep the runbook open and post step completions.

samir: Acknowledged. I'll be on pager and present in-channel 02:15-05:00 UTC.

priya: I'll kick the canary at 02:35 and post results (counts + latencies). Any required schema locks?

alex chen: No blocking locks — index build will be online (pt-online-schema-change). Using replica migration mode.

maria gomez: Anyone object to locking the 02:30-03:30 UTC window?

jamie: LGTM

samir: LGTM

priya: LGTM

alex chen: Locking window. Owners: maria (deploy), jamie (bot/runbook), priya (canary backfill), samir (rollback/watch), ops-runner (snapshot). I'll circulate the final step-by-step runbook in the morning.

alex chen: :thumbsup:
